summary: Tested Badge Design, Booking, and Check-in features. All 33 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Badge Design page loads with existing designs, Create/Update/Delete badge designs work, Booking creation and confirmation issues tickets with QR codes and 6-digit unique codes, Check-in Scanner dialog opens with QR scanner and manual code entry, Check-in/Undo check-in APIs work correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Invalid booking ID' instead of finding booking by code - possible routing issue with 'public' path segment

issues: Console error in SelectItem component when loading ticket type dropdown - doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Badge Design API correctly handles CRUD operations with proper validation
Booking confirmation correctly issues tickets with unique 6-digit codes and QR payloads
Check-in API properly validates codes and prevents duplicate check-ins
Undo check-in correctly reverts ticket status
Check-in stats API returns accurate counts by ticket type
seed_data_creation: Event 1 has existing booking (BK-ST5UP4DB) with 3 issued tickets, 1 badge design (VIP Badge)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Badge Design, Booking, and Check-in features fully working. Key features verified: 1) Badge Design CRUD - GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/events/1/badge-designs, 2) Booking creation - POST /api/events/1/bookings with items, 3) Booking confirmation - POST /api/events/1/bookings/{id}/confirm issues tickets with unique_code (6 chars) and qr_payload, 4) Check-in - POST /api/events/1/checkin with code (supports both 6-digit unique code and QR payload), 5) Undo check-in - POST /api/events/1/issued-tickets/{id}/undo-checkin, 6) Check-in stats - GET /api/events/1/issued-tickets/stats returns total_issued, total_checked_in, by_ticket_type. Frontend: Settings > Badge Design page shows design list with edit form, Attendees & Check-in tab shows stats and Launch Scanner button opens Check-in Scanner dialog with QR scanner and manual code entry.

badge_design_create.details: POST creates design with name, ticket_type_id, design_config

badge_design_update.details: PUT updates design colors, visible_fields, size

badge_design_duplicate.details: POST duplicate creates copy with new name

badge_design_for_ticket.details: GET for-ticket returns appropriate design by priority

booking_create.details: POST creates booking with items, calculates totals

booking_confirm.details: POST confirm changes status and issues tickets

ticket_issuance.details: Tickets issued with unique_code (6 chars) and qr_payload

undo_checkin.details: POST undo-checkin reverts is_checked_in to false

checkin_stats.details: GET stats returns total_issued, total_checked_in, by_ticket_type

frontend_badge_design_page.details: Settings > Badge Design shows design list and edit form

frontend_scanner_dialog.details: Launch Scanner opens dialog with QR scanner and manual code input
